description: Delete a defined name from a session's workbook, e.g. one you made with define_variable and no longer need. Only the name goes; the cell it pointed to keeps its value and formula. Match is by name, ignoring case, in workbook scope or, with scope_sheet, the name scoped to that sheet. A name still used by a formula is not deleted: the call fails with name_in_use and lists those cells, so rewrite them with set_inputs (or repoint the name with define_variable) first. A name that doesn't exist in that scope fails with not_found, and Excel's built-in names (print areas, filters) can't be deleted. restore_session doesn't bring a deleted name back; define_variable recreates it. Returns {deleted, scope_sheet, defined_names}, the last being every name left. To see the names first, use inspect_model.

name.description: Defined name to delete, e.g. "Exit_Cap" (case doesn't matter)

scope_sheet.description: 0-based sheet index of a sheet-scoped name; omit for a workbook-scoped name

session_id.description: Session ID returned by create_session (list_sessions shows the open ones)

name: delete_variable
title: Delete variable
